Rule30SettledBarrierEffective, Rule30WhiteSpacing: log log margins for center runs (#46)

For every constant block [a, a + L) of the center column, 5L + 18 log2(log2 a) <= 3a + 51 for black blocks from a >= 16 and L + 6 log2(log2 a) <= a + 17 for white ones from a >= 256, through backward erosion (the bound of submission R30-20261025-0554f7), reset recurrences and settling times of the left diagonals, and the spacing of the eventually white ones.

Closes #46

module_additions.message:
Rule30EdgeClock, Rule30DefectClockBudget: bounds on right-edge clocks and recurrent defect escape (#61)

A right-edge clock flips within an explicit bound from every seed, and a budget on defect clocks gives recurrent two-layer and four-layer escape at every source depth.

Closes #61
